context: Re-run the lockfile audit, trace each advisory to direct/transitive and runtime/build/test reachability, inspect upstream fixes, and prefer lockfile-compatible updates. Add CI enforcement at an agreed severity with a machine-readable exception file containing advisory, rationale, owner, expiry, and removal condition. Fail closed on new or expired high/critical advisories while avoiding blind npm audit fix upgrades.
description: The release review found npm audit reporting four advisories, three high and one low, in the Vite/PostCSS and transitive test/build dependency graph. No vulnerable code path in the shipped browser bundle or exploit was reproduced. Establish a proportionate policy that distinguishes runtime, build-time, and test-only exposure, fixes safe updates, and records narrowly scoped expiring exceptions instead of leaving audit output unmanaged.

anti_patterns.dont: allow an unbounded advisory ID or package-name wildcard
anti_patterns.instead: pin exceptions to exact advisory/range with expiry
anti_patterns.why: it would suppress future unrelated vulnerabilities

anti_patterns.dont: classify every devDependency advisory as harmless
anti_patterns.instead: document actual reachability and CI/build threat model per advisory
anti_patterns.why: build and test tooling executes trusted project inputs and can affect produced artifacts

anti_patterns.dont: run npm audit fix --force and accept the generated diff
anti_patterns.instead: apply the narrowest supported upgrade and verify build, tests, e2e, and bundle output
anti_patterns.why: unreviewed major upgrades can break the build or alter shipped behavior

preserves.behavior: A new critical or high advisory cannot hide behind an unrelated existing exception.
Application runtime behavior and production bundle size remain unchanged unless a reviewed dependency fix requires otherwise.
Every exception names an owner, exact advisory/package range, expiry date, exposure analysis, and removal trigger.
Major upgrades are evaluated explicitly and never accepted through npm audit fix --force.
The npm lockfile remains deterministic under npm ci.

prior_art.concept: Mirror the repository's existing dependency-audit aggregation and fail-closed result handling.
Run the frontend audit in an existing Node-capable lane rather than provisioning a separate duplicate environment.
Treat the committed lockfile as the audited dependency graph.

verifications.description: No unexcepted high-severity frontend advisory remains
verifications.expected: Fails on the unfixed lockfile; exits 0 after fixes or narrowly validated policy handling leaves no unexcepted high advisory.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm ci && npm test -- --run && npm run typecheck && npm run build
verifications.description: Clean install, test, typecheck, and build pass
verifications.expected: The audited lockfile installs deterministically and all frontend checks pass.
New/expired high advisories fail the gate and scoped live exceptions behave as documented.

work_units.evidence: Before-change npm audit --audit-level=high identified direct high advisories in postcss and vite plus a transitive undici high advisory through Playwright; one low @babel/core advisory remains below the blocking threshold and is intentionally visible, not excepted.
work_units.notes: Capture package, advisory, severity, direct/transitive chain, fixed version, runtime/build/test reachability, exploit preconditions, and whether the package contributes bytes to dist. Compare npm audit with upstream advisories before choosing severity or exception.
work_units.summary: Reproduce and classify every current npm advisory

work_units.evidence: Patched postcss to 8.5.25, vite to 6.4.3, and Playwright to 1.62.1; constrained transitive undici to ^7.28.0. npm ci, 851 Vitest tests, typecheck, and production build pass; generated JS bundle size is unchanged within measurement noise.
work_units.notes: Prefer patch/minor lockfile-compatible upgrades; isolate any major upgrade. Run npm ci, unit tests, typecheck, build, Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit smoke, and compare bundle composition/size for unexpected runtime additions.
work_units.summary: Apply safe dependency updates and verify the production artifact

work_units.evidence: Added npm run audit:high to the blocking Chromium browser lane and nightly parity lane, documented the non-force-upgrade/visible-low policy, and added workflow regression tests covering both gates. Full tests/unit/workflows suite passes (112 tests).
work_units.notes: If an advisory cannot yet be fixed, add an exact machine-readable exception with expiry and owner. CI fails on new high/critical findings or expired exceptions, reports low/moderate findings, and produces actionable package chains.
work_units.summary: Add an expiring audit policy and CI enforcement
